Commentary of King Fahd Complex (al-Tafsir al-Muyassar) on surah 99, verse 1–3:

Naming of the Surah

• It is called al-Zalzalah (The Earthquake), because it opens with the report of the earth's quaking before the Day of Resurrection.

From the Aims of the Surah

• Establishing the Resurrection and the Gathering, and the terrors that precede them, and discussing the precise reckoning of people for their deeds, whether good or evil; and implicit within this is the urging to do good and to avoid evil.

[Tafsir]

When the earth is shaken with a violent shaking, and brings forth what is within it of dead and treasures, and man will ask in alarm: what has happened to it?

**Commentary of the King Fahd Complex (al-Tafsir al-Muyassar) on surah 99, verses 7–8:**

Whoever does good equal in weight to a small ant will see its reward in the Hereafter, and whoever does evil equal in weight to a small ant will see its punishment in the Hereafter.
